summary: Master operational resilience for financial institutions with practical tools, scenario testing, and board-ready reporting. Enroll to strengthen readiness.
lede: Operational resilience training helps financial institution professionals identify critical services and prepare for disruption. It is designed for people responsible for operational risk, business continuity, resilience governance, or critical service delivery. They learn to map dependencies, set impact tolerances, test response and recovery scenarios, and report readiness to senior leaders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals in financial institutions who own, support, review, or report on operational resilience, business continuity, operational risk, and critical service delivery. Operational Risk Managers responsible for critical service assurance and tolerance setting. Business Continuity Managers coordinating response and recovery plans across functions. Operational Resilience Programme Leads managing resilience governance and remediation delivery. Compliance Officers tracking supervisory expectations and evidence for resilience readiness. Internal Auditors reviewing resilience controls, testing, and issue closure. Risk Analysts supporting RCSA, scenario analysis, and dependency assessments. Crisis Management Coordinators maintaining escalation paths and communication protocols. Technology Risk Managers overseeing system resilience and restoration dependencies. Third-Party Risk Managers monitoring vendor continuity and cloud concentration exposure. Operations Leaders accountable for service continuity in payments, lending, or servicing.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for workshop exercises and have access to basic spreadsheet software. Familiarity with your institution’s risk register, incident log, business impact analysis, or continuity plan will help you work faster, but the course will guide you through the methods from the ground up at an intermediate pace.
